rationale: Recent runs suggest the recurrent-tail family is still the right region, but the latest curricula were over-aggressive. This keeps the current reverse-tail recurrent structure and export path intact, while adding a tiny learned anchor-refresh gate that lets each recurrent tail block interpolate against the original decoder tail anchor and then refresh that anchor after the block update. The change is compact, compile-stable, and byte-cheap, and specifically targets the still-promising anchor-variant idea category without another scalar-only sweep.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Gate
